summary_1line: Bhishma teaches Yudhishthira that serving and honoring Brahmanas brings prosperity, power, and spiritual merit, illustrating their cosmic and social authority.

image_candidates.scene_text: The goddess Earth speaks to Vasudeva while he stands reverently upon the ground, asking how a householder may cleanse his sins.
Indra’s body covered with a thousand marks transforms into a thousand shining eyes through the power of the Brahmanas.
Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows addressing Yudhishthira about the immense power and varied nature of Brahmanas.
